description:
While Knox County schools are in session, Route 40, South Knoxville, will be on a long-term detour, for the 2:15 trip, INBOUND ONLY, Monday through Friday.

Inbound from Moody Avenue, continue straight into Sevierville Pike, left on Compton Street, left on Haywood Avenue, left on Cottrell Street, left on Wynn, right on Moody Avenue to the regular route.

description:
Due to construction along sections of MLK Jr Ave, Route 32 will be on a long-term detour.

Outbound from Oakland, right on MLK, left on Kirkwood to the Kirkwood Superstop.

From the Kirkwood Superstop, left on Magnolia, left on Lakeside, left on MLK, right on Oakland to the regular route. 

The Kirkwood Superstop is open!

Due to the closure of portions of MLK Jr. Ave., Route 31 will be on a long-term detour. 

Outbound from Kirkwood, right on MLK Jr. Ave., turn right on Lakeside, turn right on Magnolia, turn right on Park St., left on Holston Dr. to the regular route. 

Inbound from Holston Dr., right on Park St., left on Asheville Hwy. to Magnolia, left on Lakeside, left on MLK, left on Kirkwood, to the regular route. 

The Kirkwood Superstop is open!

Due to the closure of Central at Corum for utility work, Route 20 will be on a detour from 8 am to 3 pm. 

Outbound from Central, right on Morelia, left on Pershing, left on Atlantic, right on Bruhin to the regular route. 

The inbound routing wil reverse.

Due to the closure of Flag Circle at UT Medical Center on 10/17 and 10/18, the Route 42 stop will be temporarily located at Fountain Circle. 

The stop is located at the end of the awning closest to the parking garage and will be marked by temporary bus stop signs.
